Good news on that one — the Airsquitter at $985.83 is an ADS-B flight-data feeder, not a hashing miner, so power is pennies either way at 12–20¢. It earns for the coverage it provides.

Is this your first DePIN box, or adding to a setup you already run?

context.pop: What do you pay for power? I'll run the Airsquitter numbers for where you live.
